BT141-A_Wieferich_W2.interpretation: Both Wieferich primes live in Z[Phi7(3), h_E8]. W1=Phi7(3) primitive; W2 derived via 3*W1+8*(h_E8-1). Gap = 2*Phi3*M5*q where M5=31 is the same Mersenne appearing in Phi30(3)=8401=31*271.

BT141-B_Cyclotomic_Completeness.proof_sketch: 3^30-1 = Phi30(3) * prod_{d|30,d<30} Phi_d(3). Since gcd(Phi30(3),240)=1 and product identity holds, CRT implies Phi30(3) equiv 1 mod 240. Generalizes: Phi_{30k}(3) equiv 1 mod 240 for all k>=1.

BT141-C_Spectral_Cyclotomic_Bridge.interpretation: The 30th cyclotomic value at q=3 encodes the spectral moment ratio tr(A^8)/tr(A^6) via the Mersenne-5 scaling. Connects: graph spectrum (spectral moments) <-> cyclotomic number theory <-> substrate physics constants in one exact identity.

BT141-D_Orthogonal_WRF_Families.rule: Orthogonal WRF registers require seed spacing >= 100 (phase-lock collapses for adjacent seeds)
BT141-D_Orthogonal_WRF_Families.gate_set_recommendation: AND gate: seeds from same family (phase-locked). XOR gate: seeds from distinct families (isolated CIDs). OR gate: union injection from both families.
